description: The file defines the CandidateSearchFilterParams class, a Data Transfer Object (DTO) used to encapsulate filter parameters for searching candidates in the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes various fields such as candidate ID, vacancy ID, dates, status, keywords, and sorting configuration.

classes.name: CandidateSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class that encapsulates filters for candidate search queries in the recruitment module. It includes properties for candidate info, application dates, status, sorting, and other criteria, with getters and setters for each property, and initializes default sorting in the constructor.
